title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved nutrition programme in Ethiopia implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to save lives, alleviate suffering and maintain human dignity among children under five (U5), and pregnant and lactating women (PLW) in the Somali Region. The objectives of the grant is to improve the quality of nutrition services for children under five years and PLW; to improve the knowledge of mothers and caretakers on optimal feeding practices and hygiene sanitation through IYCF programme; and to increase the knowledge of basic IYCF and hygiene sanitation practices among targeted beneficiaries. OBJECTIVES: Increase capacity of existing nutrition services health system to provide lifesaving and preventative nutrition and health services to children under five and PLWOUTCOMES: Contribute toward reduced morbidity and mortality that associated with acute undernutrition (malnutrition) in children under five, and PLW in Raso and West Imi Woredas.
